Description of purpose work nature and volume:
The chosen contractor shall provide complete construction services including labor, materials, equipment, and supervision required to complete the  539-26-504   Install SCI Patient Lifts  project for the Cincinnati VAMC. This project requires the contractor to remove existing ceiling lift systems where applicable and install new Arjo Maxi Sky 600 patient lifts in designated rooms within the Spinal Cord Injury (SCI) unit. Fulfillment of this project will ensure safe and reliable patient handling, improve staff efficiency, and maintain compliance with VA standards for patient mobility equipment.
The  539-26-504   Install SCI Patient Lifts  project is intended to replace outdated ceiling lift systems and install new Arjo Maxi Sky 600 lifts in specified rooms. This construction project requires general construction, detailed inspection of existing conditions, demolition of old lift systems, installation of new ceiling tracks, electrical connections, and functional testing. Coordination with facility staff will be necessary to minimize disruption to patient care.
The above construction Statement Of Work (SOW) constitutes a basic outline of work and in no way outlines all of the details for the construction of this project.  It is recommended that a detailed inspection of the premises, drawings and specification be initiated to determine the needs and conditions for the construction of this project.
Period of Performance:
All phases of work, including project closeout documentation, to be completed & provided within 180 calendar days after issuance of the Notice To Proceed (NTP).  
The magnitude of construction project is estimated between $25,000,000 and $100,000,000;
Location of the work:
All work to be performed, according to the drawings and specifications at the:
Cincinnati VA Medical Center 
3200 Vine Street 
Cincinnati, Ohio 45220-2637
Tentative dates for issuing invitations, opening bids, and completing contract performance;
The Invitation for Bids (IFB) should be posted on/about 05-10-2026 and the Bid Opening should be within 30-45 days thereafter. 
Plans will be available for inspection without charge:
The specification and drawings will be available electronically with the IFB when released.
Date by which requests for the invitation for bids should be submitted:
There will be no physical copies provided. 
Set-Aside:
This solicitation is set-aside for service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB) concerns. 
Amount to be charged for solicitation documents:
Not Applicable.

***END OF SYNOPSIS***
